reason: EXPORT-ZIPNAME-1, a security fix (astra; @sagebrush's priority, Nov 5): Export all (.zip) refuses a member name a .zip can't hold safely (a backslash, colon, < > " | ? *, control character, Windows device name, a part ending in a dot or space, an empty, . or .. part, a leading or stray /), never renaming it: a metadata-only pass at preflight's start, before any body is read, and the writer's own check where it encodes each name (web/workspace/export/names.ts). The CLI carries the export chunk, so its growth is the chunk's: measured +2484 B on cli/pyjs.cjs at master b418745c, marked 2544.
